title: Make Agung OS the daily capture layer before building automation.
body: Before adding integrations and automation, the capture flow has to be fast enough for daily use. Start with content, products, and thoughts as the core inbox.

title: Turn content review into a weekly operating ritual.
body: Every week should have a short review of what got posted, which account it mapped to, and what kind of content should be repeated.

title: Separate personal brand ideas from commerce experiments.
body: Personal brand content and commerce experiments can overlap, but the dashboard should make their intent clear so metrics do not get mixed.
